claim: The piezo controller reports the same stage on all three of its channels: part SP-XYZ-600, serial 107866. So the three axes are one three-axis stage, not three stages.
validity_conditions: A device's report of itself, read in a preparatory run -- a read-only first contact that sent only .get commands from a list the person approved by sha256, and moved nothing. 11-21 condition 4 as narrowed at 20a688b lets such a report enter citing the run, graded as an observation by this system; it is not a measurement of any registered observable, and check 85 counts it rather than failing it. E1 from `measured:`. This is the stage model the travel-range gap said was recorded nowhere here, and it now comes from the controller rather than from inference. It says nothing by itself about travel: the model name is the controller's string, and reading a travel out of the '600' in it would be inference. Slot: the device table's piezo_stage row. A stage swap falsifies it. Delivered as items piezo_stage_part_ch1..3 and piezo_stage_serial_ch1..3 of microscope_agent/findings/microscope-20260924-2-20260924.json at a0fda99 (card 043). Checked by this seat against microscope_agent/runs/run-20260924-004/log.json read at a0fda99 (committed at 03e0cd2, unchanged since): events 36-41, each the command named and the value stated.
